objective: Reconcile the action-map tracker and Wave 2 UX status with the behavior actually present and tested on main.

criteria.promise: The tracker uses editorial labels implemented, partial, pending, and deferred with explicit evidence links, without falsely implying that those labels are all first-class BEL runtime enum values. Any repository counts stated in the docs must be recomputed from current source or removed; stale approximate action-count claims are forbidden.

The document names the exact remaining gaps for Contacts, Photos, Reminders, AI architecture, runtime MacBook validation, and LiteRT/Metal/MTP spikes without declaring runtime behavior tested when it was not.
The T-02 delta changes only the two declared tracker/status files; pre-existing product changes and untracked audit artifacts remain untouched and are not attributed to this ticket.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect the updated tables against `git log`, BELActionCatalog, focused tests, and docs/ux-wave-1.md.
verification_gates.expected: Each editorial status is backed by a concrete commit, source path, test, or an explicit runtime-validation note, and the docs state that editorial status is separate from BELActionDefinition availability.

verification_gates.procedure: Read the remaining-work sections and compare them with the current repository and the tracker reconciliation artifact.
verification_gates.expected: The document preserves unresolved runtime/AI/spike work and does not claim MacBook/TCC/Share-picker validation without evidence.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect the T-02 docs-only diff and compare it with the pre-dispatch worktree snapshot in the worker report; run `git diff --check` and inspect the two declared paths explicitly.
verification_gates.expected: The T-02 delta contains only docs/plan-action-map-v2.md and docs/ux-wave-1.md; pre-existing product/audit paths are not attributed to this ticket and diff check exits 0.

first_checkpoint.evidence: First reconciled status table with source/commit references.
